summary: SEC-001/002/003 P0 security-fix regression: 12/12 backend pytest passing (cookie flags, CORS allowlist, ?auth= removal, magic-byte upload validation, nosniff header, cookie+bearer auth). Frontend E2E confirms worker + admin login with new SameSite=Lax cookie, logout clears cookie, re-login works, /crew/me profile renders with ProtectedImg loading real 1x1 PNG via credentialed fetch, /ops/referrals renders 148 referrals across 7 tabs (settings-before-{id} route-ordering fix still intact).

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: <span> inside <option> in FeedFilters.jsx SORT_OPTIONS (dev-mode warning only, unrelated to this iteration's changes).

critical_code_review_comments: storage.validate_upload only sniffs first 8KB — fine for real images (PNG/JPEG signatures live in first bytes), but SVG-with-XML-preamble padded to >8KB could theoretically slip if filetype ever added SVG. Current allowlist rejects svg so safe today.
auth_deps.get_current_user reads cookie then Bearer — good. Consider rate-limiting the Bearer path if it becomes a public API surface (currently only used by same-origin SPA).
profile.download_file's _INLINE_SAFE_TYPES gate + nosniff + attachment-disposition combination is solid stored-XSS defense; keep this pattern for any new upload endpoints.
CORS regex/allowlist reads at import time from env — restart required to change origins (documented behaviour, fine for prod).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login+cookie flags, logout+clear, re-login, admin referrals, protected image render)

test_credentials: Used worker.demo@hcobcleaners.com / WorkerDemo2026! and admin@hcobcleaners.com / HcobAdmin2026! from /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: None. The test uploaded a real 1x1 PNG as worker avatar (persists in files collection + storage). Safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEC fixes verified end-to-end. Worker profile route is /crew/me (not /worker/profile). Admin referrals route ordering (settings before {referral_id}) is confirmed intact — page renders 148 referrals. ProtectedImg component fetches /api/files/<path> with credentials:'include' and returns blob URLs; verified naturalWidth>0 for the uploaded PNG. CORS at localhost:8001 correctly rejects unknown origins; the external URL still shows ACAO:* injected by ingress (main agent noted this is not exploitable since no allow-credentials).
